title: Vemgo-Mabas language - Wikipedia
text: Vemgo-Mabas is an Afro-Asiatic language of Cameroon and Nigeria. Dialects are Vemgo, Mabas. Blench (2006) considers these to be separate languages. Ethnologue lists a third dialect, Visik in Nigeria, which is not well attested; [1] Blench suspects it may be a dialect of Lamang instead. [2]
